blocks.text: The bottom-left panel's buttons map to a grid of keys, in order, and each shows its letter in the corner. Letters never move: whatever is selected, the first button is Q, the fourth A, the seventh Z.
The build picker on one of your worlds uses the same letters.
Rebind any key in Options > Hotkeys, which has a Reset to defaults button. Button letters follow your bindings.
A starbase builds economy and support ships; warships come from a Shipyard. With nothing selected, a letter selects every ship of one class you own, anywhere on the map.
